notes.title: 🎉 E-commerce Simulator 2025 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[b][h2]It’s time to build your empire – E-commerce Simulator 2025 is officially live! 🚀[/h2][/b]

[previewyoutube=dgQb-fWOqDs;full][/previewyoutube]

Start your journey as a digital entrepreneur today. In this full-scale business sim, you’ll set up your online store, choose what to sell, manage your inventory, and deal with real e-commerce challenges – from global logistics to customer satisfaction. 📦🛍️

We want to send a massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who followed development, played the demo, shared feedback, or just cheered us on along the way. Your support helped shape the game into what it is today, and we couldn’t be more grateful. ❤️

Now it’s your turn:
 [b]👉 Build your brand
 👉 Serve customers around the world
 👉 Become the next e-commerce giant
[/b]
[b][h3]The market is open — let’s see what you’ve got![/h3][/b]

notes.title: 📢 E-commerce Simulator 2025 launches May 1st!
notes.notes:
[h3]We’re super excited to finally reveal that [b]E-commerce Simulator 2025 is officially launching on May 1st![/b] 🗓️[/h3]

 It’s almost time to step into the fast-paced world of digital commerce, where you'll build and manage your very own online store, sell a wide variety of products, and serve customers from all over the globe. 🌍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291290/ECommerce_Simulator_2025/

Whether you’re into marketing, logistics, product trends, or just love building things from scratch — this game’s got something for you.
 You’ll face real-world challenges, find creative ways to grow your brand, and see how far you can take your virtual retail empire. 💼📈

Thanks for all your support during development — we can’t wait for you to jump in and start selling!

[h3][b]🛒 Stay tuned, and get ready to open shop on May 1st![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Mini bug fix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed issues related to the save system.
[*]Resolved the bug where exiting and re-entering the game during the 2nd mission caused the 1st mission to reappear.
[*]Fixed an issue where some items couldn’t be dropped using the "E" key.
[*]Key rebinding was not working properly, and this issue has been fixed.
[*]The internet speed upgrade wasn’t saving and would reset upon re-entering the game; this has been resolved.
[*]Fixed the problem of some papers disappearing.
[*]Resolved the issue where the night wouldn’t properly darken after exiting and re-entering the game.
[*]Fixed the bug where the fragile item sticker displayed as $1 on the machine instead of the intended $5.
[/list]
